result.title: Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree for Inference-time Search Under Sparse Reward
result.summary: Tree-based samplers offer a compelling alternative for scalable inference-time search, bypassing the per-step reward and gradient dependencies that introduce systematic bias into SMC-style frameworks. Despite this advantage, contemporary tree samplers fail to achieve broad exploration. Their reliance on learned, DDPM-like transitions inherently couples neighbor states in a trajectory, thereby restricting child-parent feature divergence in the tree sampler. Consequently, these samplers suffer from restricted coverage of the target marginal distribution, severely hindering the exploration critical for efficient search under sparse reward. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a simple yet effective Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT) sampler that decouples child node generation from explicit parent dependencies. By expanding the degrees of freedom during child node sampling, BSIT encourages diverse trajectory rollouts and unlocks broader path-space diversity-the exact catalyst needed for efficient exploration. Crucially, we show that BSIT's improved exploration accelerates convergence to the target distribution while achieving broader distributional coverage than samplers that rely on DDPM-like transitions for child-node generation, all without incurring additional function evaluations or reward feedback, thereby providing a highly efficient basis for rare target search. Extensive experiments across diverse search settings, including rare-species discovery and target-aligned molecule generation tasks, demonstrate BSIT's superior search efficiency over the baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree（BSIT）采样器：在稀疏奖励下的推理期搜索中，让子节点生成摆脱对父节点的显式依赖，以扩大采样自由度、提升轨迹与路径空间多样性，从而在不增加函数评估与奖励反馈的情况下加快收敛并扩大分布覆盖；在稀有物种发现、分子生成等任务上验证搜索效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「解耦子节点与父节点的状态转移以换取搜索多样性」及无需逐步奖励反馈的树式推理期搜索，可能为 LVR 的 latent 轨迹生成、探索多样性与动态计算/停止决策提供可核查的方法线索，但该工作属生成式采样领域，迁移性待确认。
